name: manual_92144c
claim: Before reloading a scheduled job as part of a restart, search the board for a pause instruction on it; a restart is not authority to restore a paused job. Record who authorized any reload.

decisions.notes: A coordination pulse was reloaded after an explicit pause note said not to restore it; it was found unloaded again afterwards.

rationale: A coordination pulse was reloaded after an explicit pause note said not to restore it; it was found unloaded again afterwards.
